name: NOBBLE
description: Nobble is a trick-taking card game where players compete to win tricks according to game rules. Players must manage cards and achieve scoring objectives through strategic play.

content.text: Nobble is a trick-taking card game where players compete to win tricks according to game rules. Players must manage cards and achieve scoring objectives through strategic play.

Country/Region of Origin: United Kingdom (Bolton, Lancashire)
Time Period: Early 1900s
Historical Development: Nobble is a variant of Snip Snap Snorum; described as played in Bolton, Lancashire, UK (Neil Darbyshire). Snip Snap Snorum has 19th century sources; American books from 1838 describe equivalent Snip Snap Snore 'Em.
Cultural Significance: Popular social and family game in Britain.

Minimum Players: 2
Maximum Players: 6
Optimal Players: 4
Partnerships: Optional

Type: Standard 52-card deck
Number of Decks: 1
Jokers: Not included

Score sheet (optional)
Table space

Cards per Player: Varies by player count
Dealing Pattern: Clockwise
